glyphClassification.digit: single code point in number ranges (General_Category N*)
glyphClassification.punctuation: single code point in punctuation ranges (General_Category P*)
glyphClassification.unknownFutureCodepoints: symbol until the pinned spec is explicitly refreshed

unicode.parityScope: Classification and display plans are pinned. General normalization and engine-backed segmentation have the implementation-specific limits below; exact cross-language output is guaranteed only within that intersection.

renderPlan.output: Ordered per-role display slots; slot cardinality determines head folding and cluster splitting

glyphMaterials.browser: runtime measurement and existing font leaf path; inspect fontInfo().glyphMapping diagnostics
glyphMaterials.cssAuthoring: page > tune > context > jamo > slot > parent slot > role > font; core content does not consume authored text
glyphMaterials.staticCss: original Hangul without JavaScript; arbitrary external CSS cannot be diagnosed by static renderers
glyphMaterials.structuredOutput: authoring Glyphs.capability refuses unsupported targets; FontKkuExport refuses glyph mapping designs before output
glyphMaterials.semantics: original text, semantic jamo nodes and seed indices preserved
glyphMaterials.oldHangul: existing symbol fallback unchanged; no historical rendering support added

browser.segmentation: engine Intl.Segmenter when available; code point fallback otherwise

layouts.appliesTo: page design layout > page --fy-layout > font design layout > --fy-font-layout > implicit default; a design with no layout inherits; legacy disables only design; a named sebul keeps its context layout unless a layout is explicitly selected

htmlOptions.compositionPrecedence: per-jamo design rules > page (--fy-vowel-depth/--fy-coda-depth > --fy-composition > --fy-jamo-depth) > design composition > font (longhand depth > --fy-font-composition > --fy-font-jamo-depth) > shape default (ADR-034 §3)

python.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

layouts.appliesTo: calls that name no font (missing or empty) and pass no FontDefinition; any named font, including sebul, default and whitespace-only names, keeps its context layout
layouts.depth: caller longhand > caller shorthand > layout/font default; depth arguments are applied
layouts.face: element strokes for calls that name no font, as the runtime default: the generated element table (spec/element-layer.json, ADR-027) adds data-fy-face="element", --fy-face-width and [part="hoek"] > [part="element"] to the shaped jamo nodes (initial, medial and final nodes, placed by the bundled core CSS shape rules, ADR-030) and standalone compatibility jamo; the device option keeps device glyph text at the same shape values; named fonts and FontDefinition always draw device glyph text and reject element

composition.applies: the split part (vowel, coda) through the depth path; the host gets data-fy-composition (the preset, or custom when a longhand changed an axis); none, "" and auto choose nothing
composition.diagnostic: data-fy-composition-status="COMPOSITION_UNSUPPORTED" — the pieces levels keep the default strokes in static HTML
composition.squareSplitFit: not run — a named font's non-default split keeps its font CSS places (the runtime with --fy-split-fit: none)
